# Android Release Keystore Credentials & GitHub Setup Guide

A new release signing keystore has been generated and saved locally as `release.keystore` in the root of your project directory. It is added to `.gitignore` to keep your credentials secure.

---

### Keystore Details

| Parameter | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Keystore File** | `release.keystore` (in project root) |
| **Key Alias** | `metrolist-release-key` |
| **Keystore Password** | `MetrolistPass2026!` |
| **Key Password** | `MetrolistPass2026!` |
| **Algorithm** | RSA 2048-bit (Validity: 10,000 days) |

---

### GitHub Repository Secrets Setup

To enable automated release signing in GitHub Actions workflows:

1. Open your repository on GitHub: **GitHub ➔ Settings ➔ Secrets and variables ➔ Actions**.
2. Click **New repository secret** and add the following 4 secrets:

| Secret Name | Value to Paste |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`KEY_ALIAS`** | `metrolist-release-key` |
| **`KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`** | `MetrolistPass2026!` |
| **`KEY_PASSWORD`** | `MetrolistPass2026!` |
| **`KEYSTORE`** | *(Paste the single-line Base64 string below)* |

---
